title: Standalone TABLECONTENT multiple FIELD references
mode: P5 bounded AC1027 serializer and DXF-origin replay implementation

scope.tableShape: One column, one row, one cell.
scope.fieldObjects: Two simple childless AcExpr FIELD objects with string cached values.
scope.sourceCreation: Runtime-generated locally from scratch; no persistent drawing fixture was added. DXF-origin replay starts from the generated writer output, so it is round-trip transport evidence, not an independent producer witness.

implementation.summary: The standalone TABLECONTENT writer accepts a bounded ordered sequence of supported string scalars and FIELD references. It validates every reference against the emitted FIELD identity map and applies the existing aggregate field-reference and text budgets. The library writer independently verifies the remapped output identity and written-object role for each reference before serialization.
implementation.failureAndRetry: Missing standalone FIELD targets preserve the destination sentinel and leave the caller's mutated handle intact. Correcting the target permits export through the same adapter. DXF-origin replay applies the same missing-target refusal and corrected retry.

proof.wire: ASCII and Binary output is physically scanned for the one-cell CONTENT order, remapped FIELD handles [1740,1741,1740], and the intervening string value.
proof.readback: Fresh typed readback verifies the 1x1 shape, ordered scalar/reference sequence, both FIELD identities, and repeated first target. DXF-origin replay remaps handles to 2740/2741 and preserves typed order.
proof.closure: The missing second target is rejected for adapter-authored output and DXF-origin replay without replacing the destination. Restoring the exact target enables same-adapter retry.
proof.compatibility: Existing 2x2 multiple-field grid, mixed scalar/reference ordering, childless FIELD schema, and other TABLECONTENT profiles remain covered by the same focused selector.

limits: Only the selected AC1027 one-cell sequence using simple childless string-result FIELD objects and string scalar content is implemented and exercised.

This does not qualify FIELDLIST membership, child/object dependency graphs, other FIELD body/value profiles, native expression evaluation, native TABLE rendering, DWG output, or independent producer semantics.
No whole-document closure, consumer/platform qualification, or general DWG/DXF support claim follows.
planAction: Remove the completed standalone 1x1 multi-reference serialization and remapping action from P5; retain FIELDLIST/child graphs, additional source/version forms and native semantics as open work.
